introduction: Every agent-fox tool (spec, issue, fix, impl) writes exactly one JSON envelope to stdout via internal/toolio's App.Main and Emit; today that envelope has no durable copy, so a caller that loses its own stdout pipe before reading it loses the result even though the tool finished. This spec adds a shared --output <path> flag that writes the same final envelope to a file, atomically, before anything reaches stdout, on every envelope-producing path including Emit's own internal marshal-failure fallback, and reconciles it with 06_trim_and_chain_results's --report-file when an operator points both at the same destination.

glossary.Common: The flag set every tool's Register call shares (internal/toolio/cli.go: --dir, --model, --budget, ...), where --output is added once.
glossary.Emit: internal/toolio's function that marshals the envelope and writes it to stdout, falling back to a minimal, guaranteed-encodable envelope carrying just the failure when result cannot be marshalled.
glossary.WarnCode: A declared string type identifying one warning cause; every constant has exactly one stage recorded in the central table 05_envelope_decidable establishes.
glossary.atomic write idiom: The temp-file-in-target-directory, Sync, Close, then os.Rename-over-the-destination sequence already used by afspec.Save and codeimpl's saveTasks, reused here so a reader of --output never observes a partial document.
glossary.configured destination: The resolved, absolute, cleaned path (filepath.Abs + filepath.Clean) an --output or --report-file value names, compared without resolving symlinks, independent of whether either write succeeds.
glossary.envelope: The single JSON object internal/toolio's Run.Envelope assembles and Emit writes to stdout on every invocation.

requirements.title: --output <path>, a new flag on Common
requirements.rationale: Every tool must accept the same destination flag with identical meaning, validated once, before anything is fetched, the same way --dir already is.

criteria.action: register an --output flag alongside the rest of Common's flags, defaulting to an empty string meaning nothing is written beyond stdout
resolve it to an absolute path via filepath.Abs against the process's current working directory, never against --dir's workspace root
criteria.contract: the resolved destination for the write equals filepath.Abs of the given value, regardless of --dir's value

criteria.condition: the value given to --output is exactly "-"
criteria.action: reject the invocation as a usage error before anything is fetched
criteria.contract: exit code 2; error.category is usage; no file is read or written

criteria.condition: the resolved --output path already exists as a directory
criteria.action: reject the invocation as a usage error, at the same point and for the same reason --dir's own directory check in Common.Workspace() does
criteria.contract: exit code 2; error.category is usage; caught before anything is fetched

criteria.action: perform every --output check (resolving the path, rejecting "-", rejecting an existing directory) once, as part of parsing the shared flags, before any tool's own PreCheck runs and before Workspace(), Resolve, or model resolution

requirements.title: What gets written to --output, and when
requirements.rationale: The durable copy only protects a caller if it is complete, atomic, and in place before the one copy that can vanish — stdout — is written at all, on every path that produces an envelope.

criteria.action: for any envelope-producing run given --output, write to it exactly the envelope about to be written to stdout — the same --detail view, warnings and error — except in the collision case (08-REQ-4)

criteria.condition: --output is set and an envelope is about to be produced, at either of App.Main's two Emit call sites (a flag-parsing failure, or the end of Main)
criteria.action: write the envelope to --output before writing it to stdout
criteria.contract: the file at --output is complete before any byte reaches stdout for that run

criteria.condition: Emit's own marshal of result fails and it falls back to its minimal, guaranteed-encodable envelope
criteria.action: write that same fallback envelope to --output before writing it to stdout
criteria.contract: the file at --output holds a document identical to the fallback envelope written to stdout

criteria.action: for any write to --output, create a temp file in --output's own directory, write the envelope, Sync it, Close it, then os.Rename it over the destination, so a reader polling the path never observes a partially written document

criteria.condition: --output's resolved path names a parent directory that does not yet exist, at the moment the envelope is written
criteria.action: create the parent directory (os.MkdirAll) as part of that write
still write --output exactly as it would without --dry-run, because it is local state on the machine running the tool, not a remote change

criteria.condition: the invocation is one of the two purely human-driven paths that already write nothing to stdout: -h/--help, or a bare invocation with no positional argument on a terminal
criteria.action: write nothing to --output and perform none of --output's validation
criteria.contract: no file appears at the --output path for that invocation, and no --output validation error is raised even for a malformed value

criteria.action: for any run, leave ok, status and exit_code exactly as they would be without --output, regardless of whether --output was given or whether writing it succeeded

requirements.title: A failed --output write is a warning, not a failure
requirements.rationale: Persisting a second, caller-requested copy of the result is not part of what decides whether the tool did its job, so a filesystem problem writing it must never change the run's exit code.

criteria.condition: the write to --output fails (a parent directory that cannot be created, a permission error, a full disk)
criteria.action: record a low-severity warning output_not_written naming the path and the underlying error, and leave the run's exit code and ok unaffected
criteria.contract: warnings includes an entry with code output_not_written, severity low, stage emit; exit_code and ok match what they would be absent --output

criteria.action: include output_not_written mapped to stage emit in the central WarnCode-to-stage table 05_envelope_decidable establishes
record the output_not_written warning before the single envelope for that run is assembled and written to stdout
criteria.contract: the same run's stdout envelope carries the output_not_written warning entry

criteria.condition: Emit's own internal marshal-failure fallback envelope (08-REQ-2.3) itself fails to write to --output
criteria.action: surface only the underlying error already present in that fallback's own stdout message, without adding a second, separate warnings entry for it
criteria.contract: no output_not_written entry is added to any envelope for this case, because no further envelope exists to carry one

requirements.title: Reconciling with 06_trim_and_chain_results's report file
requirements.rationale: When an operator points --output and --report-file at the same destination, only one document can exist there, and it must be the complete report, not whichever --detail view --output alone would have produced.

criteria.action: compare --output and 06_trim_and_chain_results's --report-file destination as resolved, absolute, cleaned paths (filepath.Abs + filepath.Clean), without resolving symlinks
for any pair of configured --output and --report-file values, decide whether they collide from the two configured destinations alone, independent of whether either write actually succeeds

criteria.condition: --output and --report-file resolve to the same configured destination
criteria.action: skip --output's own independent write entirely
criteria.contract: no --output write, successful or failed, is attempted at the shared path

criteria.condition: --output and --report-file resolve to the same configured destination
criteria.action: record a low-severity warning output_matches_report_file naming that both flags named the same destination, regardless of whether the report-file write itself succeeds
criteria.contract: warnings includes an entry with code output_matches_report_file, severity low, stage emit, whenever the two configured destinations match

criteria.condition: --output and --report-file collide (08-REQ-4.3) and the report-file write itself fails
criteria.action: leave nothing written at the shared path, with the envelope naming both causes
criteria.contract: no file exists at the shared path; warnings includes both output_matches_report_file and report_file_not_written

criteria.action: include output_matches_report_file mapped to stage emit in the same central WarnCode-to-stage table as output_not_written

requirements.title: Documentation
requirements.rationale: docs/cli.md is the manual a caller falls back to and must describe --output and its two new warning codes.

criteria.action: gain an --output row in the shared-flags table stating that it writes a second copy of the same envelope stdout gets, atomically, before stdout, and what happens on a collision with --report-file
gain output_not_written and output_matches_report_file rows in the warning-codes table added by 05_envelope_decidable, alongside 06_trim_and_chain_results's report_file_not_written

execution_paths.title: A supervisor that has already lost its own stdout still recovers the result from --output

steps.action: invokes fix with --output /var/run/fix-result.json and closes its own stdout pipe before the run finishes
resolves --output to an absolute path against the process's working directory and validates it before anything is fetched
writes the finished envelope to --output atomically (temp file, Sync, Close, Rename) before writing anything to stdout
polls the --output path after the tool exits and reads the complete envelope despite having lost stdout

execution_paths.title: A failed --output write is downgraded to a warning without changing the run's exit code

steps.action: runs impl with --output pointing at a destination whose parent directory cannot be created (a permission error)
attempts the atomic write to --output, the write fails, and toolio records a low-severity output_not_written warning naming the path and the underlying error
assembles the run's stdout envelope carrying the output_not_written warning, with exit_code and ok unaffected
reads the envelope from stdout, sees the run succeeded, and learns from the warning that the second copy did not land

execution_paths.title: --output and --report-file collide, and the complete report lands at the shared path

steps.action: compares the two configured, resolved paths, finds they match, and skips --output's own independent write
writes the complete, full-view report to ./run.json and toolio records the output_matches_report_file warning
opens ./run.json and finds the complete report, not the --detail summary view --output alone would have produced

execution_paths.title: Emit's internal marshal-failure fallback still leaves a durable file at --output

steps.action: returns a result value carrying a field that cannot be marshalled to JSON
fails to marshal the full envelope and falls back to its minimal, guaranteed-encodable envelope carrying just the failure
writes that same fallback envelope to --output before writing it to stdout
inspects the file at --output and finds the minimal failure envelope even though the full result could not be encoded
